hero.title: Welcome to MinimaBlog
hero.description: A clean, minimal WordPress-style blog theme built with React

about.title: About MinimaBlog
about.intro: MinimaBlog is a simple, clean WordPress theme designed for bloggers who appreciate minimalism and readability.
about.story: Founded in 2023, MinimaBlog was created with a singular mission: to provide bloggers with a clean, distraction-free platform that puts content first. We believe that good design gets out of the way, allowing your words and images to capture your reader's attention.
about.philosophy: In today's world of cluttered websites and intrusive advertisements, we wanted to create something different. MinimaBlog embodies our belief that simplicity leads to better reading experiences and stronger connections between authors and their audiences.
about.quote: Simplicity is the ultimate sophistication. Good design is as little design as possible.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.intro: Have questions about MinimaBlog? Want to collaborate? Drop us a message and we'll get back to you shortly.

faq.question: Is MinimaBlog free to use?
faq.answer: Yes, MinimaBlog is completely free to use for personal blogs. For commercial use, please check our licensing terms.

faq.question: Do I need to credit MinimaBlog on my site?
faq.answer: While not required, we appreciate if you keep the footer credit link. It helps us grow and continue improving the theme.

faq.question: Can I customize MinimaBlog?
faq.answer: Absolutely! MinimaBlog is highly customizable using WordPress customizer and additional CSS if needed.
